question: What is the meaning of bim model in relation to general information?
description: A BIM model is a digital representation of physical and functional characteristics of a facility. It serves as a shared knowledge resource to optimize decision-making throughout the project lifecycle. BIM models can store and share material properties information along with the dimension of the component (Aguiar et al., 2019). This information is crucial for sustainable construction and material reuse.
